verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit exposes a public OpenAPI spec and CLI, showing some programmatic surface beyond the web UI, but there is no documentation asserting or demonstrating that all UI functions (dashboard analytics, Triage queue actions, Change Stack chat, Slack agent, configuration UI) are mirrored via the API. Missing for 10: explicit API reference covering dashboard/triage/chat feature parity, and confirmation that API-only workflows can replace every UI action.
